identity: ONE original elderly priest, the Dawnwrit Precentor, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the old man's grey hair and trimmed white beard, the short round bronze crenellated crown with orange slits, the ivory full-length robe with burgundy lining and wide sleeves, the long red and gold embroidered front stole, the brass belt and medallions and dark brown boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE tall dark staff with bronze fittings topped by an elongated caged lantern glowing orange; the staff is a little taller than the man. The screen-RIGHT hand holds ONE open brown book with gold trim on its palm. Preserve the staff length, the lantern, the book, the robes and the elderly proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full crown, staff, lantern, book, robe and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic effects, particles or extra limbs; the lantern keeps only its small steady glow inside the cage. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the equipment. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour.

idle_h3_v1.action: A calm, devout idle that loops. The old priest breathes slowly, lifts the open book a little higher and reads, his head nodding slightly, while the staff hand shifts its grip on the upright lantern staff, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted; the robe and stole stir gently. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with measured steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate under the robe and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The lantern staff is planted and carried upright in the screen-left hand and the book stays open on the other palm. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE sweeping staff blow toward screen right. Draw the lantern staff back and up over the shoulder, then step forward into a low lunge and swing the staff around and level so the lantern end strikes out toward screen right while the book stays held, then draw the staff back upright and return to the original stance. One blow only; the staff stays in the screen-left hand. No throw.

ranged_h3_v1.action: A ranged rebuke toward screen right. He raises the open book and reads from it, then lunges forward and thrusts the lantern staff out diagonally toward screen right as if hurling its light at the enemy, holds the pose briefly, then draws back upright into the original stance. The staff and book stay in his hands; no projectile, beam or flash is drawn.

hit_h3_v1.action: One brief impact recoil and complete recovery. The head and shoulders rock backward and the knees flex while he keeps hold of the staff and the book, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Remain standing with all equipment held. The impact is shown only by the body; the blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Hunch down into a low crouch behind the upright staff, clutching the book to the chest, then hold the sheltered crouch on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A blessing recited aloud. He raises the open book high and forward toward screen right at arm's length while the staff stays upright, holds it there briefly as he reads, then lowers the book back to the original stance. Only the body and props move: no spell effect, glow or emitted light beyond the lantern's steady glow.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: the old priest staggers, sinks onto his knees leaning on the staff, then the staff tips over and he falls forward onto the ground, finishing lying motionless face down with the crowned head at screen left and the boots at screen right, the staff lying on the ground beyond his head and the book on the ground beside him. No recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
